item.title: Study Finds Coding Agent Harness Design Outweighs Model Size on Benchmarks
item.summary: A comparative study of ten coding agent harnesses, reposted by Hugging Face co-founder and CEO Clement Delangue, found that harness design produces larger benchmark accuracy swings (up to 29 percentage points) than model size differences, with vendor-tuned harnesses like Codex collapsing from 2nd to 9th place when moved from large to small models.
